newsitem.title: USA: S3 sees Q2 revs about $108 million. [CORRECTED 01:51 27/06]
newsitem.headline: S3 sees Q2 revs about $108 million. [CORRECTED 01:51 27/06]

text.p: S3 Inc said Thursday it expects to report second quarter revenues of $108 million, "plus or minus two percent."
"Given the earlier cautionary outlook for the quarter, we had hoped to see the return of a more normal pricing environment as the quarter progressed," S3 President Gary Johnson said in a statement.
"However, the pricing climate still remains competitive, both in 2D and 3D graphics, and some of our customers are working through competitive issues."
The company also projected second quarter expenses of about $35 million (corrects to read expenses instead of revenues) and gross margins around 35 percent.
